summary: Retest of auto_id compute fix in Data Jamaah (frontend only). All three targeted checks PASS: (1) After selecting Cabang=Banjarmasin + Gender=Laki-laki in Tambah Data modal, id_jamaah auto-populated to 'BR05-L-0003' matching regex BR\d{2}-[LP]-\d{4}. (2) id_jamaah input is disabled=True (readOnly) — manual typing blocked. (3) Filled remaining required fields, added 2 dynamic Ijazah Nama Dalam entries, clicked Simpan → toast 'Data berhasil ditambahkan' shown, dialog closed, and the new row with id BR05-L-0003 was searchable in the table. Cleaned up the test row via delete + confirm (success). Regression: edited existing seed JAM-0006 row — id_jamaah field displayed 'JAM-0006' unchanged (auto_id compute correctly skipped in edit mode). setRawOptions + auto_id useEffect wiring in CrudPage.js is working as designed.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` — console a11y warning (non-blocking, pre-existing).

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to CrudPage Dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
Consider computing id_jamaah on the backend at save time to eliminate race conditions when two admins create concurrently (current client-side rows.filter().length+1 is race-prone).
Consider a migration to reformat legacy JAM-#### seed IDs to new BR{cabang}-{L/P}-#### if the new format is authoritative — currently mixed formats coexist.
critical_code_review_comments: CrudPage.js auto_id useEffect uses [open, editing, form, rows, rawOptions, fields] deps — `fields` is a new array on every render from parent; not causing issues here because setForm early-returns when value unchanged, but consider memoizing fields in DataJamaah.
computeJamaahId still uses client-side sequence numbering (rows.filter.length+1) — non-atomic; two simultaneous creates can collide on the same ID.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for targeted retest (create with auto_id, disabled-field enforcement, edit-mode preserves legacy id)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one TEST_ jamaah row (id BR05-L-0003, nama 'TEST_Auto Jamaah') — table row count returned to original 8.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto_id feature is fully working. If further changes are made to CrudPage.js auto_id logic, retest by opening /admin/jamaah → Tambah Data → pick Cabang + Gender → verify id_jamaah matches BR\d{2}-[LP]-\d{4}. Route is /admin/jamaah. Radix selects: click trigger, wait 400ms, click div[role='option'] with force=True.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration_2 failure root cause (auto_id compute never invoked because setRawOptions call and auto_id useEffect were missing) is fully resolved. CrudPage.js line 64 now sets rawOptions, and lines 70-78 contain the useEffect that iterates fields with type='auto_id' and calls f.compute(form, rows, rawOptions) — gated on `!editing` so edit mode preserves persisted ids. Verified end-to-end via browser automation.
